# hookbase_webhook_endpoint (Resource)

Manages a Hookbase webhook endpoint.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Outbound webhook endpoint for a customer
resource "hookbase_webhook_endpoint" "acme_orders" {
  application_id  = hookbase_webhook_application.acme.id
  url             = "https://acme.com/webhooks/orders"
  description     = "Acme Corp order notifications"
  timeout_seconds = 15

  circuit_failure_threshold = 10
  circuit_cooldown_seconds  = 120
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (String) ID of the parent webhook application.
- `url` (String) Destination URL (HTTPS only).

### Optional

- `backoff_type` (String) Retry backoff strategy: exponential, linear, or fixed.
- `circuit_cooldown_seconds` (Number) Seconds to wait before retrying after circuit opens.
- `circuit_failure_threshold` (Number) Number of consecutive failures before opening the circuit.
- `circuit_success_threshold` (Number) Number of consecutive successes before closing the circuit.
- `description` (String) Endpoint description.
- `disabled_reason` (String) Reason the endpoint was disabled.
- `headers` (String) Custom headers as a JSON array of {name, value} objects.
- `is_disabled` (Boolean) Whether the endpoint is disabled.
- `rate_limit_per_second` (Number) Rate limit per second (0 = unlimited).
- `retry_delays` (String) Custom retry delays as a JSON array of integers (seconds).
- `success_status_codes` (String) Accepted HTTP status codes as a JSON array.
- `timeout_seconds` (Number) Request timeout in seconds.
- `use_static_ip` (Boolean) Route traffic through a static IP address.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Endpoint ID.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Webhook signing secret (whsec_...). Only returned on create.
- `secret_version` (Number) Secret version number.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
